## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-1 frozen section with model consensus and 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, others 0% (ECE 5%) | Strong Benign call, 0% risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign}, alpha 10% (90% coverage, n=132) | Single-class 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th-percentile OOD, stain severity 3 [F6] | Passes QC despite stain |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent backbones agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (82%–87%); Normal contrast 79% [F5] | All 5 neighbors Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.72, z=-2.22) lowers risk [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.32, z=1.22) favors non-invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 3, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.48, z=1.14), caption-inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-average (-0.10, z=-0.80) raises risk · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in dataset tests (deletion +0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); ignore unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation (94th-percentile OOD) on simulated frozen section masks atypia (AUROC 0.70; cells disabled).
- Duct-confined atypia (regions 5, 7, 9) is in-situ carcinoma, or superior (85%)/medial (74%) margins are involved.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 7, 9**: verify duct-confined proliferation is benign hyperplasia, not in-situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 1, 3, 11**: confirm benign tubules and uninvaded stroma, especially region 3.
3. **Regions 1, 4**: inspect superior (85%) and medial (74%) margins called clear [F7].
